rev_parse(repo, 'HEAD')
    captured = []
    code = Driver.from_config.__func__.__code__
    def observe(frame, event, value):
        if event == 'return' and frame.f_code is code:
            captured.append(value)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='serve-custody-') as directory:
        rig = CoreRig(Path(directory))
        assert_core_wiring(rig)
        llm = FakeLLM([])
        lock = Lockfile(rig.checkout.config.state_dir, instance_id='custody-probe', clock=rig.time)
        lock.acquire()
        previous = sys.getprofile()
        try:
            sys.setprofile(observe)
            result = await triage.triage_pass(rig.checkout, llm)
        finally:
            sys.setprofile(previous)
            lock.release()
        assert len(captured) == 1
        driver = captured[0]
        assert driver.journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is driver.journal
        assert result == [] and llm.requests == [] and rig.exec.calls == []
        print(json.dumps({'base': base, 'driver_uses_checkout_journal': driver.journal is rig.checkout.journal,
                          'effects_use_checkout_journal': driver.effects._journal is rig.checkout.journal,
                          'same_durable_directory': driver.journal.dir == rig.checkout.journal.dir,
                          'model_calls': len(llm.requests), 'scripted_process_calls': len(rig.exec.calls),
                          'triage_result': result}))
        driver.journal.close()
        rig.journal.close()
    assert await git.rev_parse(repo, 'HEAD') == base
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == ''
    print('Worktree clean; HEAD unchanged.')
